title: Graphitic-C3N4/TiO2(B) S-scheme Heterojunctions for Efficient Photocatalytic H2 Production and Organic Pollution Degradation
summary: Achieving both broad solar-spectrum absorption and strong redox capability is critical for semiconductor photocatalysts in environmental remediation and energy conversion. Herein, an S-scheme heterojunction photocatalyst is constructed by coupling TiO2(B) nanorods with g-C3N4 nanosheets. Its well-matched band structure extends light absorption from the UV to the visible region and enables efficient charge separation.
